label: POC Onboarding: UI Link
mcp_tool_description: Return the absolute CloudBolt UI link for a global id (RH-, ENV-, GRP-, USR-, BP-, ORD-, JOB-, SVR-, RSC-, MTA-, CF-, SCR-, IDD-) or for a named admin page, optionally with an argument after a colon: new_resource_handler:aws (also azure_arm, vmware, scvmm, gcp, acropolis, openstack), handler_edit:RH-id, handler_verify:RH-id, handler_import_locations:RH-id, environment_parameters:ENV-id, new_ldap, ldap_verify:id, ldap_mappings:id, email_settings, email_test, proxy, ssl_certificates, parameters, new_parameter, os_builds, groups, group_quotas:GRP-id, users, new_user, user_edit:USR-id, roles, portals, catalog, content_library, source_code_repos, mcp_tool_actions, rules, recurring_jobs, cit_tests, inbound_webhooks, ui_extensions, application_log, setup_wizard, dashboard. A page whose form CloudBolt opens as a dialog returns click, the button that opens it; tell the user to click it. Use it whenever the user must do something in the UI, above all when a password, key or secret has to be entered: never ask for secrets in chat, send the link. Read-only; requires a CloudBolt admin caller.
